ops.title: unregistered-launch handoff at ROTATE 561536
ops.body:
Lane unregistered-launch state at ROTATE 561536 (3:40 PM Nov 6).

Brief: /Users/yasyf/.vcache/scratch/meta-desk-3/b/unregistered-launch.md. Worktree: /Users/yasyf/repos/claude/worktrees/cc-skills/unregistered-launch (branch unregistered-launch off origin/main 5b455562f).

Mechanism found (case turn-error-91-fix-1 Sprite, turn-error-91-evidence-1 Mac): root's go 560430/560439 at 3:15:53 PM; the desk-runner started both at 3:20:33/3:20:44; the lanes registered at their first command ~3:24 (560779, 560799); the desk-runner posts SPAWNED (drive.py spawned) only in settleLaunch, on a later desk pass after the launcher exits, here 3:30:18 (561028, 561031); the supervisor folds rows only on its ~9 min lanes tick, so rows land ~3:39. lr launch start's postSpawned skips when LAUNCH_STAGE_KEY is set, and also skips the agent_readiness "unsupervised" return. Settle paths SPRITE-UNVERIFIABLE, UNVERIFIABLE, withdraw-pending and drive.py failure never post SPAWNED at all.

Plan:
1. orca/desk_launch.go: post drive.py spawned from launchLocal/launchSprite (the launch start and each fallback, with that placement), remove it from settleLaunch (and settleLaunch's placement param).
2. orca/start.go: postSpawned right after worker-start answers with a dispatch, before awaitBypass, so the unsupervised return and later failures keep a row.
3. lanes/fold.go: a state record "<lane>: registered at its first command" from a lane with no row (not root/main/supervisor/desk-runner, not a stem a live numbered lane answers under; fresh mode only if adoptable) adopts a LaneDesired row: brief <State>/<lane>/brief.md, opus/high, placement sprite when the record has an origin.
4. Tests: desk test that the spawn posts at launch start; fold test for registration adoption.
Then ship express (open-pr), title lr: 🐛 ..., merge with ccx vcs merge --admin --match-head-commit, post landed, SendMessage team-lead, done.
